title: Tank Defense
supplies: A supply drops every {{count}} kills. Chain kills within 4 seconds for up to ×3 score.
friendly_fire: Your own shells can destroy the base.
ready_help: {{lives}} lives. One base. Use the field equipment to hold the line.
paused_help: Press a movement or fire key again after resuming.
base_defeat: The base was destroyed. Watch the center lane and the flanks.
lives_defeat: All tanks were lost. Build your defense again.
local_records: Progress and records are saved on this device for your account and creative space.

frontline.name: Brick Front
frontline.note: Break through brick and hold the central lane.

river.name: Frozen Crossing
river.note: Water blocks the tracks; ice keeps them sliding.

steel.name: Steel Siege
steel.note: Armored tanks are approaching. Watch both flanks.

depot.name: Supply Depot
depot.note: Ride the belts and chain barrel blasts to open new lanes.

circuit.name: Pulse Corridor
circuit.note: Cross during the safe phase; lure enemy armor into live fields.

citadel.name: Last Citadel
citadel.note: Hold the narrow center and combine equipment to control both flanks.

mode_locked: End this run to change the operation, difficulty or map.
mode_help: Arcade modes let you try every map. Only campaign clears unlock campaign stages.

campaign.name: Campaign
campaign.note: Defend six stages. Carry lives and firepower forward.

blitz.name: 90-second blitz
blitz.note: Clear one map in 90 seconds. Faster reinforcements; start at firepower 2.

survival.name: Endless defense
survival.note: Survive growing waves. 5-second breaks; recover a life every third wave.

time_defeat: Time ran out. Use barrels and upgrades to clear the map faster.
barrel_help: Shoot to blast tanks and brick within the dashed ring. Keep your distance.
conveyor_help: Pushes both sides in the arrow direction. Steer against it.
pulse_help: Amber warns for 1 second, then the field turns live. Briefly stuns tracks; guns still fire.
repair_help: Restores one lost life and grants a short shield. Single use.

garage.title: Character garage
garage.empty: Characters created by an Agent appear here.
garage.new_battle_help: Starts a fresh battle with a frozen character version.
garage.session_error: This session could not be loaded. Check its expiry, account and workspace.
garage.library_error: The character library is unavailable. Refresh to retry.
garage.save_error: The request failed. Your selection is preserved; try again.
garage.conflict: The character changed or the request conflicts. Refresh the library before modifying it again.
garage.editor_help: Choose parts within the 9-point budget. Combat stats are compiled from these choices.
garage.name: Tank name
garage.invalid_draft: Use a name of 1–40 characters and keep parts within the 9-point budget.
garage.copy_error: Copy failed. Select and copy the configuration above.
garage.connect_help: This MCP connects the Agent to the current workspace’s character library and tank game.
garage.connect_credentials: Use a CLI with the tanks mcp command and sign in to this environment with the same account. Auro agents inherit their task credentials. Tokens do not belong in this configuration.
garage.agent_example: Ask your Agent: Create a green light tank, validate and save it, then launch a campaign on the Frontline map and return the play URL.
garage.login_command: Sign in to this connection profile

casual.name: Casual
casual.note: 5 lives, bonus armor and a 3-hit base. Slower enemies, no base friendly fire; keep upgrades after death.

standard.name: Standard
standard.note: 3 lives, a 1-hit base and full enemy speed. Your shells can destroy the base.

fullscreen_unavailable: Full screen is unavailable in this browser
fullscreen_error: Could not enter full screen. Try again or allow full screen in your browser.
friendly_fire_safe: Your shells cannot damage the base.
